data.title: Payments, Billing & Coach Payouts | TrainZilla Help
data.description: Set up Razorpay UPI, card and wallet payments, then automate revenue-share payouts to every coach — no manual invoice — plus GST invoices, from one dashboard.
data.keywords: TrainZilla payments, Razorpay Route payouts, automatic coach payouts, UPI payments for coaches, revenue share software for personal trainers, GST invoices

_rationale: The old description mentioned 'enable payouts' as one item in a list, burying the differentiator this cycle's competitive research found missing everywhere else (FLiiP/Wellyx automate franchisor-level payouts, not a no-invoice coach revenue share). Rewritten to lead with the automatic, no-invoice payout mechanism. Feature anchor: Razorpay Route payouts [GAP].
